verdict.rationale: Supabase hosts customer data and ships a dashboard AI Assistant, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is used to train AI models. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, no training opt-out, and no statement about how AI Assistant or MCP data is retained. The nearby items do not address the story: CLI telemetry opt-out covers usage telemetry, self-hosting is pitched only as general data control, and SOC 2 compliance is a general audit, so none of them shows a training opt-out.
